description: Better Soil, Better Climate is a case study listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by The Ohio State University Department of Food, Agricultural, and Biological Engineering; The Ohio State University | Carbon Management and Sequestration Center; USDA Natural Resources Conservation Service. The soil health management system an Ohio farmer practices increases crop productivity, reduces costs for fertilizer and pesticides, and sequesters carbon in the soil. Both locally and globally, he encourages other farmers to adopt his methods. Coverage: Ohio (2017). The toolkit gives Ohio as the location, 2017 as the year. The listed link gives the documented application. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the cited source documents and the outcomes reported were not checked, and no model or dataset used was verified. It can support comparison with similar adaptation projects and planning precedents. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
